outcome: mRNA expression of oligodendrocyte lineage pathways
mRNA expression of neurotransmitter pathways (dopaminergic, glutamatergic, GABAergic)
cohort: The study included preterm (GA64) and term (GA69) guinea pig pups delivered via cesarean section.
finding: Zuranolone treatment in preterm-born guinea pig offspring prevented a hyperactive phenotype, ameliorated preterm-related reductions in MBP, and restored preterm-related alterations in mRNA expression of dopaminergic, glutamatergic, and GABAergic pathways.
gest_age: Preterm pups at GA64, term pups at GA69
